What you are actually owed

121 real programmes, every one checked against its official source. Each says plainly what it is — money you keep, money you repay, or free help — and names the free path where somebody normally charges you for it.

GRANT31 programmes

GRANT — money you do not repay (eligibility-gated)

LOAN6 programmes

LOAN — you repay this, with interest

COST-SHARE2 programmes

COST-SHARE — you pay first, reimbursed after inspection

TAX CREDIT6 programmes

TAX CREDIT — reduces taxes owed, no cash up front

INSURANCE8 programmes

INSURANCE — risk coverage you pay premiums for
